title: Open Design: Local-First Open Source AI Design Engine
summary: Open Design is a local-first design artifact generator that integrates with multiple coding-agent CLIs to provide an open-source alternative to Claude Design. It uses a skill-based architecture and supports offline generation by scanning the user's system for available AI agents.
research_notes: Dual-licensed under Apache-2.0 and MIT. It follows a 'Bring Your Own Key' model and features a unique 'Skills are files' system for extending agent capabilities via Markdown.

evolution.summary: Since its launch, the project has evolved from basic agent adapters to a sophisticated platform featuring cross-session memory and the 'Critique Theater' replay system. Major updates added support for a wide range of agents including Devin, DeepSeek, and Mistral, along with a visual gallery for artifact management.
